keywords: Business and Ethics 2.Corporate Social Responsibility 3.Work Style Reform 4.Environment and Economic Practice 5.Globalization and Ethics
educationalGoal: This course aims at acquisition of knowledge about business ethics and skills to solve problems which an engineer in a corporation could encounter. This course also aims at development of presentation skills. This training serves to foster the skills for using statistics and decision-making to ethical problems.
advice: This course consists of three part. First, ethical theories(class#2 to #4). Second, case studies(#5 to #9) and presentation seminar(#10 to #14). Classes are composed as follows: #1: Introduction #2 to #4: Ethical Theories(Normative Ethics, Egoism, Utilitarianism, Deontology, Theory of Justice, Stakeholder and Stockholder Theory and Corporate Social Responsibility) #5 to #9: Case studies(Abuses in Personal Data , 'Black Enterprise', Suicide from Overwork, 'Work Style Reform', Dismantling of Oil Excavator, Biofuel and Destruction of Rainforest, and Fair trade). #10 to #12: Presentation Preparation. Making presentation slides by group working. #13 to #14: Presentation seminar. #15: Self-Evaluation. Mini tests(class #1-#10) and report(about 2000 letters in Japanese) are required. Be careful for articles about business ethics on newspapers and the Internet. Preparations for the lecture is also required.
books: Ethics of Business, Mitsuhiro Umezu, Maruzen, 2002.
requiredKnowledge: Be aware of ethical problems concerning business and economy. Be sensitive about economy and practice of corporation through media and the Internet.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand and explain fundamental business ethics theories and corporate social responsibilities.
Be able to understand and explain ethical problems of labor practice.
Be able to understand and explain ethical problems of consumers.
Be able to understand and explain environmental problems caused by economic activities.
Be able to analyze ethical problems of business and find the solutions.
Be able to self-evaluate your achievement from the viewpoint of the target abilities.
